title: F[T]/(minimal polynomial of theta) is isomorphic to F(theta)
statement: Let $F\subseteq\Omega$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension] and $\theta\in\Omega$ algebraic over $F$ [def-weil-algebraic-element], with minimal polynomial $\mu\in F[T]$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] (the monic polynomial of least degree with $\mu(\theta)=0$; $F[T]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring]). Let $F(\theta)$ be the smallest subfield of $\Omega$ containing $F$ and $\theta$. Then $\deg\mu\ge1$, and the $F$-algebra homomorphism $F[T]\to\Omega$, $T\mapsto\theta$, induces an isomorphism of $F$-algebras $F[T]/(\mu)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(\theta)$ sending the class of $T$ to $\theta$. In particular $F(\theta)=\{g(\theta):g\in F[T]\}$.
